messages:
maya_ae: Hey team — new POC with CypherWave starts next week. Customer wants to bring a custom quantized 14B variant and has tight latency asks (<60ms 1-token ideally) plus KV-cache persistence across retries. Need quick catalog compatibility check and any infra or security blockers. @diego_se can you validate adapter + tokenizer? @chris_ml can you weigh in on quant/kernel impact? Alex (customer) is looped in.

diego_se: On it. Quick clarifying Qs: are they shipping a custom SentencePiece tokenizer (vocab + model) or standard BPE? Also which instance family are they planning (GCP A2 vs. AWS g4dn)? That affects our adapter builds.

alex_customer: We’re using SentencePiece v0.1, vocab + spm model uploaded to our bucket (link below). POC infra will be GCP A2 (T4) for initial tests, may move to A100 later. Concurrency low (<10), but single-token latency is important for snappy UX. BYOK is required for keys. Link: gs://cypherwave-poc/vocab.tar.gz

chris_ml: Important detail — the variant uses group-wise 4-bit quant (q4_k_m-like). That affects KV cache layout and some fused attention kernels. If it’s q4_k_m-compatible we can serve via our quant path, but might need a small kernel tweak for best latency. Memory should be fine but we should bench.

priya_security: Two quick asks from security: 1) BYOK/KMS workflow — do they expect us to import their key or wrap it? 2) Data residency / logs retention for POC. I’ll send the short intake checklist, need answers to complete the SCC.

olivia_salesops: Pricing / contract note: for a 3-week POC I suggest a limited Dedicated trial (reserved pool) with a consumption cap and a short-term rate card. I’ll draft an estimate comparing T4 vs A100 runs and call out attachment costs (storage + egress).

diego_se: Adapter checklist notes (quick draft):
```
model_registry_name: cypherwave-14b-cust-v1
artifact: s3://customer/cypherwave/14b/q4_k_m/
tokenizer: sentencepiece-0.1 (provide spm + vocab)
route_policy:
  use_kv_persistence: true
  max_concurrency: 12
  quant_format: q4_k_m
```
We’ll need the vocab and the spm file present and a small tokenmap shim if they renamed special tokens.

chris_ml: Action item for perf: I’ll run the quant-compat check locally with the tool: `rwi-quant-check --model ./model --format q4_k_m --dry-run` and do a quick p50/p95 latency baseline on a dev T4. If we see kernel misses, I’ll propose a fallback kernel or slight model tweak. Will run tomorrow morning.

maya_ae: Alex — can you upload the 20–30 sample prompts you want used for the POC eval and confirm if any prompts will include long context (>2k tokens)? Also confirm SLA expectations for the POC (availability vs production).

alex_customer: Uploaded vocab + sample prompts to gs://cypherwave-poc/ (vocab.tar.gz + eval_set.jsonl). No >2k contexts in the demo. BYOK: yes we require customer-managed keys (we’ll provide credentials for import).

olivia_salesops: Noted BYOK. I’ll include BYOK handling in the POC SOW and flag any costs for HSM import if needed. Preliminary cost ballpark will be posted later today.

priya_security: For BYOK we need: key policy, rotation cadence, and confirmation we can do zero-knowledge wrap. I’ll start the security intake now and send the short form to @alex_customer.

diego_se: Next steps (owner tags):
- chris_ml: run quant compatibility + latency baseline (owner: chris_ml)
- diego_se: verify tokenizer integration and produce adapter spec + tokenmap shim if needed (owner: diego_se)
- priya_security: start security intake for BYOK & residency (owner: priya_security)
- olivia_salesops: POC pricing + SOW draft (owner: olivia_salesops)
- maya_ae: coordinate kickoff and collect any remaining artifacts from customer (owner: maya_ae)

maya_ae: Thanks all — I’ll schedule a quick 30m sync after chris posts the perf numbers. :thumbsup:
